title: BULLET SIZE FAIRY expresses fearlessness with outstanding single “skin”
htmlContent:
BULLET SIZE FAIRY's latest single "skin," featuring Georgiy Mkheidze, is one of those songs that have the power to resonate. It shows an artist ready to pour their heart into their work. "skin" grabs your attention with its energy, balancing moments of strength and vulnerability.

The production is bold and adventurous, much like the artist themselves. BULLET SIZE FAIRY creates a soundscape where deep emotions blend with a bit of chaos. "skin" speaks to individuality, creativity, and the struggle to be noticed.

https://open.spotify.com/track/6TBuYiKOvW1aKPQwLd1sqH

Every part of the song has a real sense of urgency, as though BULLET SIZE FAIRY is determined to make their voice heard. "skin" is for anyone who has ever felt like they had to fight for their place in the world. BULLET SIZE FAIRY is stepping into the music scene and making a strong entrance.
